data.one_liner: Flutter toast and notification widget library
data.what_it_does: Provides a flexible API to show toast notifications with multiple styles and queueing. Supports custom content, animations, and hover interactions.
avoid_when: Need push notifications instead of in‑app toasts
weaknesses: Requires manual import of wrapper for context‑free use
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, optionally wrap root widget with ToastificationWrapper

alternatives.name: overlay_support
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides overlay‑based toasts with less configuration
